title: Lab retest of the marble finds no iridium

tellings.quote: So I can already tell like this is going to be nowhere near dense enough for a heavy metal like uh aridium.

related.note: This is the same marble and the same question of what it is made of as telling 4, but Zodakis's lab retest finds no iridium, so the two claims contradict each other.

plain: A small marble said to come from a UFO crash site had earlier tested at about 40% iridium, a rare, very heavy metal, but a second lab test found no iridium at all. The man who ran the retest in his own lab, Matthew Zodakis, describes it on the show. Weighing the marble in his hand, he says it is "nowhere near dense enough for a heavy metal like iridium", which undercuts the earlier result that had made the marble look exotic.
